As a Line Operator, you’ll join a dynamic department equipped with multiple machines and over 30 colleagues working in a 3-shift system. You’ll be involved in the entire production process — from start to finished products. Think: peanut butter in all kinds of varieties, made for a wide range of customers. If you have a technical mindset (or are eager to learn!), you’ll fit right in!

Your daily responsibilities as a production worker include:

- Operating and setting up the machines that produce our products

- Troubleshooting minor technical issues

- Performing basic maintenance on the machines

- Testing the final products for quality and consistency

3-shift system (06:00–14:15 and 14:00–22:15 and 22.00 - 6.15

Requirements for working as an Line Operator:

- Willingness to work in a production environment (including exposure to food products)

- Basic understanding of English or Dutch

- you´ve allready worked or show intressed In a production enviorment 

- Willing to help your co-workers on the production line 

We do not provide accomodations. You need to live in the serroundings of Giessen.

The holiday season is just around the corner! You can imagine the amount of mail that PostNL Nieuwegein has to process during this period. That’s why Manpower is looking for mail sorters! Will you become one of these sorting heroes? Apply today!

Where will you be working?

Grote Wade 80 

3439 NT Nieuwegein

When will you be working? 

We have several shifts open. Quickly scroll down to the Working hours section for all the options!

Good to know! After 1 December, we expect an increase in work related to the festive season. From then on, more services will be available.

What will you need at least?

    - Own transport, because the location can not be reached by public transport
    
- Availability of at least 15 hours per week from Monday to Friday
    
- Good understanding of the Dutch and/or English language

What will you be doing? 

Sorting mail! You do this using a sorting machine. You check, label and sort all mail so that it can be delivered to the right address.

What do you get out of it?

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour (excluding shift bonus)
    
- Shift bonuses between 20% and 40% (depending on the shift) 
    
- Flexible, part-time position of at least three shifts a week (if you want and there is work available, we will be happy to schedule you more!)
    
- Travel expense allowance in accordance with the PostNL collective labour agreement 

Earn a €100 net referral bonus! This is how it works: you propose someone who would also like to work as a mail sorter at PostNL. If you have both been working for at least two weeks, the bonus will be credited to your account! 

    - Availability of at least three shifts per week
    
- At least seventeen years old (you must be at least eighteen years old to work evening and/or night shifts)
    
- Good enough understanding of the Dutch and/or English language to be able to comprehend the safety instructions
    
- Able to perform physically heavier work, as you mainly work standing up and lift parcels up to fift

As an Assembly Employee, you are responsible for assembling plastic protection materials for high-tech products. You work accurately based on technical drawings and continuously check the quality of the final product.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling plastic components according to technical drawings
- Performing quality checks on dimensions and finishing
- Checking tolerances and product specifications
- Reporting deviations and improvement opportunities
- Processing and handling plastic materials
- Working together with colleagues from production and logistics
- Maintaining a clean and safe workplace

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- 06:00 - 15:00
- 15:00 - 00:00

You will receive additional compensation for weekend overtime.

For this position, we are looking for someone with technical insight and experience within a production environment.

Important requirements:

- Experience with plastic processing or plastic welding
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Able to work well in a team

As a Cleanroom Foil Employee, you will work in a clean production environment where high-tech components are packaged and protected for international transport. You will work accurately based on technical drawings and work instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Cutting foil using production machines for high-tech packaging
- Packaging fragile components for air transport
- Cleaning and packing products and components
- Assembling packaging materials according to instructions
- Working according to cleanroom rules and safety procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the workplace and cleanroom environment clean and organized

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday from 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday from 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience as an assembly or production employee is a plus
- Technical insight and interest in production processes
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard region is a plus

As an orderpicker / warehouse worker, you make sure that all orders are collected accurately and neatly. Using a handheld scanner or picking list, you move through the warehouse and collect the correct products.

Your responsibilities

- Collecting orders using a picking list or handheld scanner
- Checking that products are complete and correct
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Moving products within the warehouse
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe
- Working together with your colleagues to complete everything on time

You will work from Monday to Friday, from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (07.00 till 16.00), so you are free in the evenings and weekends

As an orderpicker / warehouse worker, you have:

- Experience as an orderpicker, warehouse worker or simular in the logistics would be great but is not required
- Availability for 40 hours per week
- A hands-on attitude and the physical fitness to stand and walk throughout the day
- No Dutch required, English is enough
- Residence in or near Oss, Nijmegen or Wijchen

You’ll soon be working for a company that specializes in producing all kinds of stone worktops. These worktops are sold throughout the Netherlands and Germany and eventually end up in people’s homes, so there’s a good chance that you already have one of their worktops in your own kitchen!

Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!

- Available to work a day shift from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm

Monday to Friday in 2 shifts: 06:00 - 15:00 / 15:00 - 00:00. 

A cleanroom is a very clean and sterile working environment: designed to limit or, if possible, exclude contamination from the product process. The contamination may consist in dust or fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine dust or chemical vapors. The production of medicines and microelectronics, but also, for example, the cultivation of bacteria in Petri dishes, require a cleanroom environment to varying degrees.

In this position you work in a production/cleaning environment. Of course, you also test products. In addition, your daily work as a cleanroom process operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech parts (technical parts) following instructions and protocols.
- Perform assembly and cleaning work.
- Performing quality measurements.
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint).

To succeed in this role, it is preferable that you already have technical knowledge / technical experience in a cleanroom or any other production environment.

In additional, we ask for the following:

- Engagement and enthusiasm.
- You recognize yourself in the following keywords: involved, stress resistant, positive, responsible, team player, visionary, helpful, precise and safety first.
- English language skills, since all safety instructions, work instructions and social conversations are in English.
- You are able to work in a structured and independent manner.
- You are able to read technical drawings and work according to work instructions
- You live in the area of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel or Valkenswaard.

Are you experienced in a cleanroom environment and do you understand the importance of accuracy, quality, and discipline? Then this could be the next challenge you are looking for!

What are you going to do?
As a Cleanroom Operator, you will work in a modern ISO Grade 2 cleanroom where high-value, mainly metal components are cleaned, inspected, and packaged.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning precision parts according to strict procedures
- Performing visual quality inspections using UV and blue inspection lights
- Operating cleaning installations and drying machines
- Vacuum packing cleaned products
- Inspecting components for contamination and damage
- Working according to cleanroom and quality standards
- Handling valuable high-tech components with great care

What do we offer?
- Starting salary of €15.92 gross per hour, excluding shift allowance
- With the 18% shift allowance, your hourly wage increases to €18.79 gross per hour
- You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule:
- One week Monday to Friday: 06:00 - 14:30
- Other week Monday to Thursday: 14:30 - 23:30 and Friday off
- Average working week of 38 hours
- Enjoy a long weekend every other week
- Extensive onboarding and training program of 3 to 4 months
- Personal guidance from experienced colleagues during your training period

Where will you work?
You will join a modern and professional working environment where quality, teamwork, and respect are key values. The atmosphere is informal and friendly, with colleagues supporting each other whenever needed. Because many international employees work at this location, English is the primary language on the shop floor.

In addition to a great workplace, employees enjoy excellent facilities, including a modern cafeteria with fresh fruit provided weekly, vending machines for snacks and drinks, and a separate relaxation area featuring a table football game. It is a pleasant environment where you can get to know your colleagues and unwind during break
